[{"proname":"admin_resolve_order_flag","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_resolve_order_flag(p_flag_id uuid, p_note text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\nbegin\n  if not public.am_i_admin() then\n    raise exception 'admin only' using errcode = '42501';\n  end if;\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);\n  update public.order_review_flags\n     set resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = auth.uid(), resolution_note = left(coalesce(p_note, ''), 500)\n   where id = p_flag_id and resolved_at is null;\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);\n  if not found then raise exception 'Flag not found or already resolved'; end if;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"delete_my_account","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_my_account()\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  v_res jsonb;\nbegin\n  if v_uid is null then\n    raise exception 'Not authenticated';\n  end if;\n  -- Transaction-local flag so the orders guard (Phase 1A, part B2) lets this\n  -- server-side cleanup anonymise the user's orders, including the FK\n  -- ON DELETE SET NULL updates fired by the auth.users delete below. Only this\n  -- function sets it; clients cannot set custom GUCs through the API.\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);\n  v_res := public.erase_user_data(v_uid);\n  if v_res->>'status' = 'admin_blocked' then\n    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);\n    raise exception 'Admin accounts cannot be deleted from the app';\n  end if;\n  delete from auth.users where id = v_uid;\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"push_tokens_cap","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_tokens_cap()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nbegin\n  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated')\n     and not exists (select 1 from public.push_tokens where expo_push_token = new.expo_push_token)\n     and (select count(*) from public.push_tokens where user_id = new.user_id) >= 10 then\n    raise exception 'Too many registered devices.' using errcode = '54000';\n  end if;\n  return new;\nend $function$\n"},{"proname":"register_push_token","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_push_token(p_token text, p_platform text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\ndeclare v_uid uuid := auth.uid();\nbegin\n  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'Not authenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;\n  if p_token is null or p_token !~ '^Expo(nent)?PushToken\\[[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\\]$' then\n    raise exception 'Invalid push token' using errcode = '22023';\n  end if;\n  if p_platform is null or p_platform not in ('ios', 'android', 'web') then\n    raise exception 'Invalid platform' using errcode = '22023';\n  end if;\n  if not public.rate_limit_hit('push-register:' || v_uid::text, 30, 3600) then\n    raise exception 'Too many requests' using errcode = '54000';\n  end if;\n\n  insert into public.push_tokens (user_id, expo_push_token, platform, updated_at)\n  values (v_uid, p_token, p_platform, now())\n  on conflict (expo_push_token) do update\n    set user_id = excluded.user_id, platform = excluded.platform, updated_at = now();\n\n  -- keep only this user's 10 most recent devices\n  delete from public.push_tokens\n  where user_id = v_uid\n    and id not in (select id from public.push_tokens where user_id = v_uid order by updated_at desc limit 10);\nend $function$\n"},{"proname":"release_due_wallet_credits","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_ids uuid[];\n  n integer;\nbegin\n  -- Called from get_my_wallet() under the student's role: tell the\n  -- block_client_writes backstop this write is ours (transaction-local).\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);\n\n  -- Anti-farming: a credit whose referrer and friend have logged in from the same IP address is\n  -- HELD for an admin (never granted automatically, never denied automatically: classmates on the\n  -- same Wi-Fi or mobile network share an IP too). One flag per friend order; once an admin resolves\n  -- it (admin_resolve_order_flag) the credit releases, or they reject the referral (admin_reject_referral).\n  insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)\n  select l.order_id, l.user_id, 'referral_shared_network', 0, 0,\n         jsonb_build_object(\n           'referrer_id', l.user_id, 'friend_id', o.user_id, 'credit_ledger_id', l.id, 'credit_amount', l.amount,\n           'signal', 'the two accounts have logged in from the same IP address',\n           'caveat', 'college / hostel Wi-Fi and mobile-carrier networks share one IP between many people, so this can be two genuine classmates',\n           'recommended_action',\n             'Decide whether these are two accounts of the same person. If they are NOT, resolve this flag and the credit releases on the next run. If they ARE, reject the referral (admin_reject_referral) - that cancels the credit.')\n    from public.wallet_ledger l\n    join public.orders o on o.id = l.order_id\n   where l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.source = 'referral_reward' and l.status = 'pending'\n     and l.available_at <= now() and l.user_id is not null and o.user_id is not null\n     and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)\n     and public.accounts_share_network(l.user_id, o.user_id)\n  on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;\n\n  with due as (\n    update public.wallet_ledger l\n       set status = 'available'\n     where l.entry_type = 'credit'\n       and l.status = 'pending'\n       and l.available_at <= now()\n       and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)\n       -- a credit earned by a payment that is being disputed stays held\n       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu\n                        where pu.order_id = l.order_id and pu.status = 'disputed')\n       -- ... nor while a shared-network review is open\n       and not exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags f\n                        where f.order_id = l.order_id and f.reason = 'referral_shared_network' and f.resolved_at is null)\n    returning l.id, l.referral_id\n  )\n  select array_agg(id), count(*) into v_ids, n from due;\n\n  update public.referrals r\n     set status = 'rewarded', rewarded_at = now()\n   where r.status = 'qualified'\n     and exists (\n       select 1 from public.wallet_ledger l\n        where l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward'\n          and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.status = 'available'\n     );\n\n  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);\n  return coalesce(n, 0);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"user_owns_chapter","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_owns_chapter(p_chapter_id text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\n  select\n    public.am_i_admin()\n    or exists (\n      select 1\n      from public.chapters c\n      join public.purchases p\n        on p.user_id = auth.uid()\n        and p.status = 'success'\n        and p.course_id = c.course_id\n      where c.id = p_chapter_id\n        and (\n          (p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)\n          or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)\n          or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)\n          or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any(p.year_ids))\n        )\n    );\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"wallet_balance_of","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wallet_balance_of(p_user uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(available numeric, pending numeric, total_earned numeric, next_available_at timestamp with time zone)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\n  select\n    greatest(0,\n      coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'available'\n                                     and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())), 0)\n      - coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type in ('debit', 'reversal') and status = 'available'), 0)\n    )::numeric(10, 2) as available,\n    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as pending,\n    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status in ('pending', 'available')\n                                   and source = 'referral_reward'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as total_earned,\n    min(available_at) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending') as next_available_at\n  from public.wallet_ledger\n  where user_id = p_user;\n$function$\n"},{"proname":"wallet_ledger_no_overdraw","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wallet_ledger_no_overdraw()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_bal numeric;\nbegin\n  if new.user_id is null or new.entry_type not in ('debit', 'reversal') or new.status <> 'available' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  -- same lock key as create_priced_order / settle_razorpay_payment\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || new.user_id::text, 0));\n  select coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'available'\n                                        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())), 0)\n       - coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type in ('debit', 'reversal') and status = 'available'), 0)\n    into v_bal\n    from public.wallet_ledger where user_id = new.user_id;\n  if v_bal < new.amount then\n    raise exception 'wallet_ledger: a % of % would overdraw the wallet (available %)', new.entry_type, new.amount, v_bal\n      using errcode = '23514';\n  end if;\n  return new;\nend;\n$function$\n"}]
